source.note: Plan row 202 (Quaternius static Dagger via poly.pizza) is blocked, so this is Dagger_2.fbx from Quaternius's own CC0 Medieval Weapons Pack on OpenGameArt (same author, licence on the page; the same zip and pin as the sword and axe entries). The pack has two daggers: Dagger (a curved, back-notched scimitar-like knife with a hooked steel guard) and Dagger_2 (a straight, symmetric, double-edged dagger with a gold crossguard and gold faceted pommel); Dagger_2 was taken because its straight blade is the plainest dagger silhouette and reads at a glance in the hero view (its edges have a few small stylized notches). Height 0.35 m is the whole dagger, pommel to tip. Rest pose: upright, tip at +Y, pommel on y = 0; blade flat in the XY plane (edges along X, about 2.5 cm wide, crossguard about 7 cm wide along X, 3 cm thick along Z); symmetric, so the blade axis is on x = z = 0 (the model origin is the pommel's bottom centre). Pommel 0 to 0.03 m, cord-wrapped grip from y 0.03 to 0.135 m (hold at about y 0.085 m), crossguard 0.135 to 0.165 m, blade 0.16 to 0.35 m. To put it in a hand: parent to the hand, offset by -0.085 m along the dagger's Y, then rotate so Y runs along the fist's thumb direction (or against it for a reverse grip). Colours match the sword and axe: blade pale steel (moon over sky), grip amber over sky, crossguard and pommel gold over sky (gold threshold -0.1 so the small guard reads gold, not shade, from the front).
